column10: SELECTED. Replaces the ADS1115 and its I2C bus. Stocked at BOTH UNIT and LCSC (C48263, ~15.9k, ~$1.71 @100) - stock checked 6 Nov 2026, re-verify before ordering. Internal PGA is the PRIMARY front end. Verify input common-mode range with PGA enabled at 3.3 V against the load cell (open item 4).

Cannot be specified until the load cell datasheet is available (open item 4). Check whether the excitation can serve as the ADS1220 external reference for a ratiometric measurement, which would cancel excitation drift.

column2: Relay, 12 V coil, contact NORMALLY OPEN - ARM
column10: Energised by the station ARM key. Must be NO so DISARMED is the de-energised state.

column10: Energised only while the station FIRE button is held.

column2: Relay, 12 V coil, contact NORMALLY CLOSED - SHUNT
column10: MANDATORY NC. Shorts the e-match pair whenever disarmed (D-008). Releases only when K1 pulls in.

column10: Held in by its coil. E-STOP breaks the coil circuit so it drops out.
